transcript: My friend, have you ever noticed how your eyes grow heavy when you speak with someone you love? Many people think this means boredom, but listen closely. It is the opposite. When you are with someone you truly trust, your body finally lets go. The nervous system softens. The guard you carry through the world slowly lowers. Stress fades. The breath deepens. The heart slows its rhythm. This sleepiness is not weakness, it is safety. Just as a child relaxes in the arms of a mother, your body recognizes a quiet truth. I am safe here. I do not need to stay alert. Peace can feel like tiredness to a world that is always tense. Calm can feel strange to a mind used to survival. So if you yawn beside your partner, do not judge it. Do not overthink it. It may simply mean your soul has found a place where it can rest. If this message spoke to you, stay close, follow and share your thoughts below. We are here to remember what the heart already knows.
